title: Menu Item - Spacer

fields.label: Spacer
fields.name: spacer
fields.instructions: Renders this menu item as an empty separator instead of a link. Only takes effect on Footer Menu items nested under a top-level column (not the column headings themselves) — see partials/layout/footer.php.

description: ACF's nav_menu_item location applies to every menu item across every menu (no per-location scoping in ACF itself) — the "only Footer sub-items" restriction is enforced in partials/layout/footer.php, not here.
